title: Memory Capture: Claude remembers past sessions
summary: Automatically turns finished Claude Code (and Codex) sessions into short, durable decision notes, so later you can ask 'what did we decide about X?' and get an answer.
how_to_use: Install it, then ask "what did we decide about…", "have we done this before?" or "search memory for…".
requires: Claude Code. Originally set up with a ~/JesseOS/vault folder; tell Claude where you want your notes kept.
